title: languas hainanensis
intro: Languas hainanensis, commonly known as the Hainan tongkat ali, is a plant species in the family Zingiberaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to improve mental clarity and physical performance, while also serving as an adaptogen to help the body adapt to stress. The health benefits of Languas hainanensis include reducing fatigue, anxiety, and depression, as well as improving sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, which exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and neuroprotective properties.
